_comment: Config for the visitor identification pipeline. See directives/visitor_identification.md. Flip `mode` to 'live' and set `rb2b_script_id` to cut over to a real RB2B account — nothing downstream of the webhook receiver changes.
_comment_pixel: Live-mode pixel. `rb2b_script_id` is the ID from RB2B dashboard > Script Setup. The CDN host and snippet version are RB2B's, verified against their install guide.
_comment_webhook: RB2B has no HMAC/signature verification, so their documented auth is a random token in the URL. Rotate this before deploying anywhere public.
_comment_resolver: Mock-only. match_rate 1.0 makes every US visitor resolve (demo default). Real RB2B lands nearer 0.3. us_only mirrors RB2B resolving US traffic only. send_repeat_visits mirrors RB2B's opt-in repeat-visitor toggle (default off = initial visit only).
_comment_variants: Which email variants run, in rotation. Defined in execution/visitor_identification/email_variants.json. These six were approved from a variant matrix; peer_frame and proof_point were reviewed and not selected. blind_spot auto-routes to leads that already own a BI tool and ultra_short to companies under 60 staff, regardless of rotation order.
